# SOYL

> SOYL is a Persian & Lebanese restaurant in Dubai Design District (d3), Dubai.

## About

SOYL serves Persian (Iranian) and Lebanese cuisine — kebabs, mezze and fresh bread from a fire-led open kitchen — in a dining room centred on an olive tree. Location: Building 7, Ground Floor, Dubai Design District (d3), Dubai, UAE. Price range: AED 50–100 per person. Outdoor seating available. Opening hours are not listed here; please contact the restaurant to confirm.
